mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO study_plan_progress (plan_id, phase_id, user_id, status) VALUES
(#{item.planId}, #{item.phaseId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, phase_id, user_id, status, notes, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM study_plan_progress WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY phase_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE study_plan_progress SET status = #{status}, notes = #{notes}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'completed' THEN NOW() ELSE completed_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE phase_id = #{phaseId} AND user_id = #{userId}
